experiments.label: Foundation resources
experiments.help: Makes gold ore, iron ore, silica and cotton available in the map editor. Existing maps and building costs are unchanged.

experiments.label: Landscape resources
experiments.help: Makes jungle, pine and dead trees, ruins, camp-sites, ancient debris, scrub, tall grass, maize, potatoes, rice and fish available in the map editor. They use existing materials and rules; existing maps are unchanged.
